title: Clover-35B-A3B-Preview Technical Report
abstract: arXiv:2611.24636v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce Clover-35B-A3B-Preview (Clover), a mixture-of-experts diffusion language model with 35 billion total parameters and 3 billion activated parameters, supporting thinking-mode generation. Clover adapts Gated Delta Networks to block diffusion by combining recurrent memory of previously generated context with bidirectional softmax attention inside the current block. Historical memory readout competes with current-block tokens in a shared softmax, with learnable block-size calibration and a separate, zero-initialized right-context convolution branch. Clover leads the seven evaluated agent metrics, including 73.6 on SWE-bench Verified and 51.7 on Terminal-Bench 2.1. On internal agent workloads, it reaches a reported generation speed of 680 tokens/s using one NVIDIA GB300 GPU at BF16 precision and batch size one. We organize the evaluation around model quality, drafting and verification costs, and deployment under constrained memo

translated_abstract: 我们介绍 Clover-35B-A3B-Preview（简称 Clover），这是一个混合专家扩散语言模型，总参数量为 350 亿，激活参数量为 30 亿，支持思考模式生成。Clover 将门控 Delta 网络（Gated Delta Networks）适配到块扩散范式中，将先前已生成上下文的循环记忆与当前块内的双向 softmax 注意力相结合。历史记忆读取与当前块内的 token 在共享 softmax 中进行竞争，并配备可学习的块大小校准以及一个独立的、零初始化的右上下文卷积分支。Clover 在全部七项被评估的智能体指标中均处于领先地位，其中包括 SWE-bench Verified 上的 73.6 分和 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上的 51.7 分。在内部智能体工作负载上，使用单块 NVIDIA GB300 GPU，在 BF16 精度和批量大小为 1 的条件下，其报告的生成速度达到 680 tokens/s。我们围绕模型质量、草拟与验证成本以及受限内存条件下的部署来组织评估。
tldr: Clover 是一个总参数 350 亿、激活参数仅 30 亿的混合专家扩散语言模型，其创新在于将门控 Delta 网络的循环记忆与块内双向注意力结合以适配块扩散，在智能体基准上全面领先（SWE-bench Verified 达 73.6 分），并在单块 GB300 GPU 上实现 680 tokens/s 的生成速度。
en_tdlr: Clover-35B-A3B-Preview is a mixture-of-experts diffusion language model with 35B total and 3B activated parameters that adapts Gated Delta Networks to block diffusion by combining recurrent memory with bidirectional intra-block attention, achieving leading agent benchmark results (73.6 on SWE-bench Verified) and 680 tokens/s generation speed on a single NVIDIA GB300 GPU.
